title: 第014章 天狼星的恐惧第015章 天狼星联合军
slug: 全民修仙之系统上交囯家
content_zh:
华纪55年12月20日，天狼星，天狼殿。
天狼大帝的伤已经养了十天，胸口的焦黑印记依然没有完全愈合。那道伤不是普通的皮肉之伤，而是张德华拳罡中蕴含的核爆毁灭之力留下的道伤，合体境的恢复力也无法快速抹除。每当他低头看到那个拳头大的印记，脑海中就会浮现出那个疯子从核爆火球中冲出的画面——浑身燃烧，右臂碳化，眼睛比太阳还亮。
天狼殿内，气氛压抑得像暴风雨前的闷热。数百位化神境长老分列两侧，没有人敢说话。十天前那场惨败的消息已经传遍了整个天狼星域，一百八十万大军被打得溃不成军，二十多万修士阵亡，天狼大帝本人重伤逃回。这是天狼星立域十万年来最惨重的失败。
“都哑巴了？”天狼大帝坐在王座上，声音沙哑，目光如刀般扫过所有人，“本帝召集你们来，不是让你们当木头的。说！怎么办！”
长老们面面相觑，终于，大长老硬着头皮站了起来。
“星主，华夏联盟的实力远超我们的预估。他们的武器——那些叫‘导弹’和‘反物质炮’的东西——我们的飞舟和护盾根本挡不住。还有那个张德华……”大长老顿了顿，声音低了下去，“他能吸收核爆能量，一拳打伤星主。此人虽然只是化神，但战力堪比合体。”
天狼大帝的脸色更加阴沉。大长老说的是事实，但事实往往最伤人。
“本帝问你怎么办，不是让你重复本帝有多无能！”
“属下不敢。”大长老连忙低头，“属下的意思是，单凭我天狼星一己之力，恐怕难以抗衡华夏。必须联合周围星系的其他修仙文明，组成联军，共同对抗。”
“联合？”二长老皱眉，“那些小文明，平时对我们毕恭毕敬，那是怕我们。现在我们吃了败仗，他们还会听我们的吗？”
“不听也得听。”三长老冷冷道，“华夏的野心不只是天狼星，他们是要征服整个星域。那些小文明不联合，早晚也是被各个击破。告诉他们，要么一起打，要么等死。”
长老们议论纷纷，有人支持联合，有人觉得联合也没用，有人建议求和，有人建议死守。争论声越来越大，几乎要掀翻大殿的穹顶。
“够了！”天狼大帝一掌拍在扶手上，王座上的裂纹又多了几道，“求和？谁提议求和的？”
大殿里瞬间安静下来。所有人的目光都看向角落里一个缩着脖子的长老——那是七长老，化神后期，主管外交事务。
七长老硬着头皮站出来：“星主，属下不是怕死。属下是实事求是。华夏的张德华，化神一重就能打伤您。现在他可能已经突破了，我们拿什么打？与其等他们打过来，不如主动求和，进贡称臣，保我天狼星十万年基业……”
“放屁！”天狼大帝猛地站起身，合体境的气息如火山爆发般喷涌而出，将七长老震退了数步，“本帝堂堂合体境，天狼星域第一强者！你让本帝向一个化神小辈称臣进贡？！”
七长老跪在地上，浑身发抖：“星主息怒，属下只是……”
“只是什么？只是没骨气！”天狼大帝走下王座，一步步走到七长老面前，“本帝活十万年，什么大风大浪没见过？一个化神小辈，仗着几件铁疙瘩，就敢骑到本帝头上？求和？本帝宁死不屈！”
他一脚踢开七长老，转身走回王座。
“传令下去，从今日起，天狼星进入最高战备状态。所有飞舟集中待命，所有修士取消休假，所有资源优先供应军队。同时，派使者前往周围星系，联络所有修仙文明，组建‘星域联军’。告诉他们——华夏不除，天狼星域永无宁日！”

“是！”长老们齐声应道。
散会后，天狼大帝独自坐在空荡荡的大殿中。王座上，他的手指无意识地敲着扶手，发出单调的“哒哒”声。
“华夏……张德华……”他喃喃道，眼中闪过复杂的光芒。
他承认，他怕了。不是因为张德华的实力比他强，而是因为张德华的那种疯狂——那种不惜自残、不惜同归于尽的战斗方式。他活了十万年，见过无数对手，但从未见过这样的人。一个不怕死的人，是最可怕的敌人。
但他不能让别人知道他怕。他是天狼星主，是合体境强者，是这片星域的王。王，不能低头。
远处，天狼星外港，残存的飞舟正在紧急维修。修士们的士气低落到了极点，到处弥漫着恐惧和绝望的气息。
“听说华夏要打过来了？”一个金丹修士小声问旁边的同伴。
“还用听说？星主都败了，他们肯定会打过来。”
“那怎么办？我们打得过吗？”
“打不过也得打。跑？往哪跑？整个星域都是华夏的目标。”
两人对视一眼，都从对方眼中看到了相同的情绪——绝望。
天狼星的恐惧，从高层蔓延到了底层，从大殿扩散到了每一个角落。
华纪55年12月25日，华夏基地，阅兵广场。
今天是圣诞节，但华夏联盟没有人过这个节日。对华夏军人来说，今天只有一个意义——第三卷即将结束，第四卷即将开启。
阅兵广场上，一千名远征军将士列队而立。他们是华夏联盟最精锐的战士，修为全部在金丹巅峰以上，每个人都经过了时间加速修炼室的严格训练，每个人都做好了为华夏牺牲的准备。他们的眼神坚定如铁，身姿挺拔如松，一千人站在那里，像一千把出鞘的利剑。
张德华站在检阅台上，右臂的新生肌肉已经完全恢复了力量。化神二重的气息内敛到了极致，看起来就像一个普通人。但所有将士都知道，这个“普通人”能一拳打伤合体境的天狼大帝。
“同志们。”张德华的声音通过扩音器传遍整个广场，“今天，是华纪55年的最后一周。再过几天，我们就要迎来新的一年。这一年，我们做了很多事——我们统一了修仙星球，破解了上古仙府，研发了空间折叠技术，建立了星际舰队。我们打退了天罡宗，打退了天狼星，让那些看不起我们的人知道了——华夏，不可欺！”
广场上响起热烈的掌声。
“但是。”张德华抬起手，掌声立刻停止，“这一切，只是开始。天狼大帝逃了，天狼星的主力还在，周围星系还有更多的修仙文明对我们虎视眈眈。如果我们停下来，就会被吃掉。所以，我们不能停。”
他顿了顿，目光扫过每一个将士的面孔。

“第四卷，我们将走出这个星系，征服天狼星，开启华夏的星际时代！这不是梦想，是计划。空间折叠战舰已经下水，远征军正在扩编，物资正在储备。几个月后，我们将再次出发。这一次，不是为了防守，是为了进攻。不是为了保家，是为了卫国。不是为了打退敌人，是为了消灭敌人！”
他握紧拳头，高高举起。
content_en:
December 20, 55 AD, Sirius, Sirius Hall.
Emperor Sirius has been recovering from his injuries for ten days, and the scorched black mark on his chest still has not completely healed. That wound was not an ordinary flesh wound, but a wound left by the destructive power of the nuclear explosion contained in Zhang Dehua's fist, and the recovery power of the Fusion Realm could not quickly erase it. Whenever he looked down and saw the fist-sized mark, the image of the madman rushing out of the nuclear fireball would appear in his mind - his whole body burning, his right arm carbonized, and his eyes brighter than the sun.
In the Sirius Palace, the atmosphere was as oppressive as the sultry heat before a storm. Hundreds of elders in the realm of gods were lined up on both sides, and no one dared to speak. News of the disastrous defeat ten days ago has spread throughout the Sirius Star Territory. The 1.8 million army was defeated and defeated. More than 200,000 monks were killed. The Sirius Emperor himself was seriously injured and escaped. This was the most disastrous failure in Sirius's 100,000-year history.
"Are you all mute?" Emperor Sirius sat on the throne, his voice hoarse, and his eyes swept over everyone like knives, "I have summoned you here, not to make you a piece of wood. Tell me! What should I do!"
The elders looked at each other, and finally the elder stood up bravely.
"Star Lord, the strength of the Chinese Alliance far exceeds our expectations. Their weapons - those things called 'missiles' and 'anti-matter cannons' - our airships and shields cannot stop them at all. And that Zhang Dehua..." The elder paused and lowered his voice, "He can absorb the energy of nuclear explosions and hurt the Star Lord with one punch. Although this person is only a god, his combat power is comparable to that of a combined body."
Emperor Sirius's face became even more gloomy. What the Great Elder said is the truth, but the truth is often the most hurtful.
"When I ask you what to do, I don't mean to ask you to repeat how incompetent I am!"
"I don't dare." The great elder quickly lowered his head. "What I mean is that I, Sirius, may not be able to compete with China with my own strength. We must unite with other immortal civilizations in the surrounding galaxies to form a coalition to fight together."
"Unite?" The second elder frowned, "Those small civilizations usually treat us with respect because they are afraid of us. Now that we have been defeated, will they still listen to us?"
"You have to listen even if you don't want to." The third elder said coldly, "China's ambition is not just Sirius, they want to conquer the entire star field. If those small civilizations do not unite, they will be defeated sooner or later. Tell them, either fight together or wait to die."
The elders discussed a lot, some supported the alliance, some thought it was useless, some suggested suing for peace, and some suggested sticking to it. The argument became louder and louder, almost toppling the dome of the hall.
"That's enough!" Emperor Sirius slapped his hand on the armrest, and there were more cracks on the throne. "Suing for peace? Who proposed to sue for peace?"
The hall fell silent instantly. Everyone's eyes were focused on an elder with a hunched neck in the corner - that was the Seventh Elder, a late-stage god in charge of foreign affairs.
The Seventh Elder stood up bravely: "Star Master, I am not afraid of death. I am seeking truth from facts. China's Zhang Dehua can injure you at the first level of his divine transformation. Now that he may have broken through, what should we use to fight? Instead of waiting for them to come over, why not take the initiative to seek peace, pay tribute and become a vassal, and protect our 100,000-year foundation of Sirius..."
"Fart!" The Sirius Emperor suddenly stood up, and the aura of the Fusion Realm spurted out like a volcanic eruption, knocking the seven elders back a few steps, "I am the most powerful person in the Fusion Realm, the strongest one in the Sirius Star Territory! You want me to pay tribute to a junior god-former?!"
The seventh elder knelt on the ground, trembling all over: "Star Master, please calm down, this subordinate is just..."
"Just what? Just spineless!" Emperor Sirius stepped down from the throne and walked step by step in front of the seventh elder, "I have lived for a hundred thousand years, what big storms and waves have I not seen? A junior god-former, relying on a few iron knots, dares to ride on my head? Sue for peace? I would rather die than surrender!"
He kicked the seventh elder away, turned around and walked back to the throne.
"The order is passed, and from today onwards, Sirius will enter the highest combat readiness state. All flying boats are on standby, all monks are canceling their vacations, and all resources are given priority to the army. At the same time, envoys were sent to the surrounding galaxies to contact all immortal civilizations and form a 'star coalition'. Tell them - until China is eliminated, there will never be peace in the Sirius Star Territory! "
"yes! "The elders responded in unison.
After the meeting, Emperor Sirius sat alone in the empty hall. On the throne, his fingers tapped on the armrest unconsciously, making a monotonous "tap-tat" sound.
"Hua Xia...Zhang Dehua..." He murmured, with a complicated light flashing in his eyes.
He admitted that he was afraid. It's not because Zhang Dehua is stronger than him, but because of Zhang Dehua's craziness - that kind of fighting style that doesn't hesitate to harm himself or die together. He has lived for a hundred thousand years and has seen countless opponents, but he has never seen anyone like this. A person who is not afraid of death is the most terrible enemy.
But he couldn't let others know that he was afraid. He is the Lord of Sirius, a strong man in the Fusion Realm, and the king of this star field. King, you cannot bow your head.
In the distance, at the outer harbor of Sirius, the remaining spaceships were undergoing emergency repairs. The morale of the monks was extremely low, and there was an atmosphere of fear and despair everywhere.
"I heard that China is coming to attack? "A golden elixir monk asked his companion next to him in a low voice.
"Do you still need to hear about it? The Star Lord has been defeated, they will definitely fight. "
"What should we do? Can we beat it? "
“You have to fight if you can’t beat it. run? Where to run? The entire star field is China's target. "
The two looked at each other and saw the same emotion in each other's eyes - despair.
Sirius' fear spread from the top to the bottom, from the main hall to every corner.
December 25, 1955, Huaxia Base, Military Parade Square.
Today is Christmas, but no one in the Chinese Alliance celebrates this holiday. For Chinese soldiers, today has only one meaning - the third volume is about to end and the fourth volume is about to begin.
On the parade square, a thousand soldiers of the expeditionary force stood in formation. They are the most elite warriors in the Chinese Alliance, and their cultivation levels are all above the peak of the Golden Core. Everyone has undergone rigorous training in the Time Acceleration Training Room, and everyone is ready to sacrifice for China. Their eyes were as firm as iron, and their postures were as straight as pine. A thousand people stood there like a thousand unsheathed swords.
Zhang Dehua stood on the reviewing stand, and the new muscles in his right arm had fully recovered their strength. The aura of the second-level God Transformation is extremely restrained, and he looks like an ordinary person. But all the soldiers knew that this "ordinary man" could injure the Heavenly Wolf Emperor in the Fusion Realm with one punch.
"Comrades. "Zhang Dehua's voice spread throughout the square through the loudspeaker, "Today is the last week of the 55th year of Chinese history. In a few days, we will usher in a new year. This year, we did a lot of things - we unified the planet of cultivating immortals, cracked the ancient immortal mansion, developed space folding technology, and established an interstellar fleet. We defeated the Tiangang Sect and Sirius, letting those who looked down on us know that China cannot be bullied! "
There was warm applause in the square.
"But. "Zhang Dehua raised his hand, and the applause immediately stopped, "This is just the beginning. Emperor Sirius has escaped, but the main force of Sirius is still there, and there are more immortal civilizations in the surrounding galaxies that are eyeing us. If we stopped, we would be eaten. So, we can't stop. "
He paused and glanced at the faces of each soldier.
"In the fourth volume, we will leave this galaxy, conquer Sirius, and start China's interstellar era! This is not a dream, this is a plan. The space folding battleship has been launched, the expeditionary force is expanding, and supplies are being reserved. In a few months we will be heading out again. This time, it's not for defense, but for offense. It's not to protect the family, it's to defend the country. Not to repel the enemy;Destroy the enemies! "
He clenched his fists and raised them high.
